summary: Round 1, from scratch. The generic arms all end on the start's traps (control / speed-equiv slide into kill sheet *18 at 5.7-5.9; per-call energy and death charge camp on the platform). Go-Explore never leaves the pit, but its archive holds the record's post-pit corridor (a trough under the platform) reached via the platform's SW corner. A backward curriculum on that 10 s GE line (uf2r1b2_tc, from scratch) took the greedy line to 7.43 at 101M (9/9 at 7.1-7.4%, curriculum at the true start by ~100M). The next gate is energy: the line lands on a floor at z 548 (E 1,177 -> 623) and leaves the trough too slow to clear *18's west edge. Running uf2r1b2_tce = tc + per-call energy shaping K8; next a GE energy search from the policy's own fall.
